tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active remote postings using explicit filters. Ordered by first discovery, newest first. Returns compact summaries and an optional cursor; does not assess personal eligibility.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read a posting, its current catalog status, description and original application link. Closed/stale jobs may be returned; check status before recommending.

tools.name: get_filters
tools.description: Get accepted location, category, seniority and employment keys, plus an alphabetical sample of currently observed skills.
